subject: Accessing elements names within plyr calls

messages.author: fc22cb727156ff4f
messages.subject: Accessing elements names within plyr calls
parts:
Hi all,

Here is a simple example:

d <- list(a=runif(10), b=runif(20))

ldply(d, function(x) {
do.something(x)
})

Is there a way to access the names a and b within the function applied
by ldply. I would like:

ldply(d, function(x) {
if (names(x) == "a")
do.something(x)
if (names(x) == "b")
do.something.else(x)
})

of course my use case is a little less basic that that (I need to pass
the name to some other function) but the basic principle is the same.
So I need to resort to a for loop?

JiHO

messages.subject: Re: Accessing elements names within plyr calls
parts:
Hi Jiho,

Two ways:

d <- list(a=runif(10), b=runif(20))

llply(seq_along(d), function(i) list(d[[i]], names(d)[i]))
mlply(cbind(x = d, n = names(d)), function(x, n) list(x, n))

Hadley
